meta.title: Attentive: book a psychologist
meta.description: Find a psychologist and book a session online or in person, without waiting on WhatsApp.

home.title: Find someone you can actually talk to.
home.lede: {count, plural, =0 {Our psychologists} one {# psychologist} other {# psychologists}} in Jakarta, BSD and Malang, or online from wherever you are. Pick a time that suits you and it is booked straight away.
home.step1: Choose who the sessions are for, how you'd like to meet and where. Every psychologist shows their next open time.
home.step2: Open times are live, so what you see is what you get. Your booking is confirmed straight away.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: We keep only what is needed to arrange your sessions: your name, contact details and your booking times.
privacy.p2: We never store what you talk about with your psychologist, and our emails never mention why you are seeing one.
privacy.p3: Check-in emails are sent only if you agree to them, and you can stop them at any time.
